title: Ceph OSD
description: One Ceph OSD: state, latency, I/O, BlueStore internals, slow ops and scrubs.

panels.title: Disk
panels.description: Physical device(s) and model/serial under the OSD's LVM volume.

panels.title: Op latency
panels.description: Total latency includes time in the OSD's op queue; processing excludes it.

panels.title: BlueStore slow ops
panels.description: Counted per interval; nothing drawn when there were none.

targets.expr: (rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{job="node", role="proxmox"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (host, device) group_left (ceph_daemon) (label_replace(label_replace(max by (ceph_daemon, instance, devices) (ceph_disk_occupation{ceph_daemon="$osd"}), "host", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"), "device", "$1", "devices", "(.*)"))

defaults.noValue: No data from node_exporter (job=node, role=proxmox) for this OSD's disk
